columns.description: Agency location code of the submitter.

columns.name: ORIGINATOR_ALC
columns.description: Agency location code of the originator.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ALC
columns.description: Agency location code of the customer.

columns.name: CONTACT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the contact person for the transaction.

columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the contact person.

columns.description: Phone number of the contact person.

columns.description: Number of detail lines in the transaction.

columns.name: ACCOMPLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the transaction was accounted in the system.

columns.name: CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number used to identify a contract between two trading partners.

columns.name: TRX_CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number used to identify a contract between two trading partners.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Purchase order number of the transaction.

columns.name: CLIN_NUMBER
columns.description: Contract line item number of the transaction.

columns.name: REQUISITION_NUMBER
columns.description: Requisition number of the transaction.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of items in the transaction.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_ISSUE
columns.description: Number of items that are being issued.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price of an item in the transaction.

columns.name: DETAIL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Detail amount of the transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment for the transaction line amount is full or partial. Valid values are F and P.

columns.name: FY_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Obligation identifier for the fiscal year.

columns.name: RECEIVER_TAS
columns.description: Receiver's treasury account symbol.

columns.name: RECEIVER_BETC
columns.description: Identifies the receiver's type of activity (gross disbursement, offsetting collection, investment in Treasury securities, etc.) and the effect of a transaction on the Fund Balance With Treasury. It is used in combination with the Treasury Account Symbol to classify transactions reported to Treasury through all Governmentwide Accounting financial management systems.

columns.name: RECEIVER_DUNS
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number of the receiver.

columns.name: RECEIVER_DUNS_OR_UEI
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number of the receiver or the Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) for the System for Award Management (SAM) database that uniquely identifies entities that do business with the federal government.

columns.name: RECEIVER_DUNS_PLUS_4
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number plus 4 of the receiver.

columns.name: RECEIVER_DUNS_PLUS_4_OR_EFT
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) plus 4 or the Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) indicator of the receiver.

columns.name: SENDER_TAS
columns.description: Sender's treasury account symbol.

columns.name: SENDER_BETC
columns.description: Identifies the sender's type of activity (gross disbursement, offsetting collection, investment in Treasury securities, etc.) and the effect of a transaction on the Fund Balance With Treasury. It is used in combination with the Treasury Account Symbol to classify transactions reported to Treasury through all Governmentwide Accounting financial management systems.

columns.name: SENDER_DUNS
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number of the sender.

columns.name: SENDER_DUNS_OR_UEI
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number of the sender or the Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) for the System for Award Management (SAM) database that uniquely identifies entities that do business with the federal government.

columns.name: SENDER_DUNS_PLUS_4
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number plus 4 of the sender.

columns.name: SENDER_DUNS_PLUS_4_OR_EFT
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) plus 4 or the Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) indicator of the sender.

columns.name: RECEIVER_DEPARTMENT_CODE
columns.description: Department code of the receiver.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Accounting classification code for the transaction.

columns.name: ACRN_NUMBER
columns.description: Accounting Classification Reference Number that identifies a line of accounting on a contract.

columns.name: JOB_PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Job (Project) Number of the transaction being processed.

columns.name: JAS_NUMBER
columns.description: A number that is a combination of the Job Order Number, Accounting Classification Record Number, and Site-ID for the transaction being processed.

columns.name: FSN_AAA_ADSN_NUMBER
columns.description: Subdivision of ALC, an accounting station.

columns.name: OBLIGATING_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: The billing agency’s internal accounting document associated with a specific bill or disbursement.

columns.name: ACT_TRACE_NUMBER
columns.description: The Accounting Trace (ACT) Number, a user-assigned identification number, for the transaction being processed.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Additional information to describe and support the transaction.

columns.name: MISCELLANEOUS_INFORMATION
columns.description: Additional miscellaneous transaction information.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the transaction from the original transaction. Valid values are P, C, or A.

columns.name: IPAC_DOCUMENT_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Document Reference Number for a transaction.

columns.name: SENDER_DOS
columns.description: IPAC Disbursing Office Symbol for the ALC sending the transaction.

columns.name: SENDER_DOS_ALC
columns.description: IPAC Disbursing Office Symbol for the ALC sending the transaction.

columns.name: DODAAC_CODE
columns.description: Identifies a Department of Defense activity location.

columns.name: TRX_CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: The email address of the IPAC transaction contact of the seller agency.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CONTACT_PHONE
columns.description: The phone number of the IPAC transaction contact of the seller agency.

columns.name: VOUCHER_NUMBER
columns.description: Voucher number for the transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DOS
columns.description: IPAC Disbursing Office Symbol of the sender of the original Payment or Collection transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DOS_ALC
columns.description: IPAC Disbursing Office Symbol of the sender of the original Payment or Collection transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOMPLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Original accoumplished date of the transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Original accounting date of the transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DOCUMENT_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Original document reference number for a transaction.

columns.name: SUMMARY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Summary amount of the transaction.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code for the IPAC transaction record type that indicates whether the transaction is inbound or outbound. It is based on the lookup type ORA_FV_IPAC_RECORD_TYPE. Valid values are I and O.

columns.name: USSGL_TRANSACTION_CODE
columns.description: USSGL transaction code for outbound transactions.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_NUMBER
columns.description: USSGL transaction code for outbound transactions.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_NAME
columns.description: Taxpayer name for the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_SET_CODE
columns.description: The code that identifies the transaction set. Examples of values are 820 (indicating payment), 810 (indicating collection), and so on.

columns.name: IPAC_BILLING_ID
columns.description: Billing identification number for the transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer involved in the transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the customer transaction.

columns.name: CREDIT_DEBIT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of transaction and whether it is a credit transaction or a debit transaction. Valid values are: C, D.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction is accounted.  Valid values are: Y,N.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
